candidates.name: LIDAR DTM Time Stamped Tiles
verified_facts: Site-specific LiDAR surveys have been carried out across England since 1998 and may repeat over time.
Available DTM resolutions vary from 25cm to 2m according to survey requirements.
The DTM removes surface objects using bespoke algorithms and manual editing to produce terrain-only surface.
Data is supplied on the OS Grid with elevations above Ordnance Datum Newlyn and declares +/-15cm RMSE vertical accuracy.
The transformation is specific to survey period and metadata identifies survey date, product resolution, transformation and geoidal model.
semantic_limits: A time-stamped DTM tile can support lineage validation only when the parcel is joined to the exact survey/tile metadata; generic archive availability does not authorize numerical substitution.

candidates.name: LIDAR Composite Catalogues
verified_facts: The official dataset is an index for full-coverage LiDAR surveys of England.
It is published by the Environment Agency as a catalogue/index dataset linked to LiDAR composite products.
semantic_limits: Catalogue membership or coverage is provenance evidence only; it does not by itself prove the exact raster bytes, survey date or parcel elevation used by the SHA-bound primary result.
